kitEvidence.formula:
Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5) × 100]% for [1.5] seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional @spell.PowerBall:PowerBallDamage@ magic damage and are Knocked Up for [0.75] seconds.

Rammus then creates [3] aftershocks in the area over [3.5] seconds, repeating the Slow.

The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed.
